name: online-coop-hud
format: 1x CSS px + @2x authoring px. Textless art to ship; -en previews for review. Phone-light: sparse cream/honey chrome, 48 CSS px minimum taps, no heavy frames in the playfield.
strokes: 2 CSS px (4 @2x) on controls; 3 CSS px (6 @2x) on frames. Floor 1 CSS px.
font: Runtime: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif. Mockups: DejaVu Sans / DejaVu Sans Bold (no emoji; 🌼 and 💤 are omitted in rasters).

world_tag.recipe: Paste glyphs/{species}.png into the cream well of tags/world-p{1,2,3}.png. Well centre ≈ (28, 24) in 1x CSS px; glyph top-left ≈ (12, 8). No player names.
world_tag.why_new: online/ui rings fill the centre with the shape mark, so a glyph would fight them. Wide nameplates (tag-pN.png) only have a ~20 CSS px face well. New hollow 56 CSS px tags keep colour+shape and leave a 32 px well. Official rings and wide nameplates stay referenced, not copied.

portrait.note: Closed button sits in the lower-right thumb rest, clear of a jump/act cluster in the extreme corner. Open centre is inset so a full 8-bubble ring (radius 128 + 28 bubble radius = 156) stays inside 390×844.

landscape.note: Closed button in the right-thumb rest. Open centre is inset so a full ring (radius 120 + 28 = 148) stays inside 844×390.

edge_clamp.show_when: A friend’s world position is outside the visible viewport, or within 16 CSS px of an edge.
edge_clamp.rule: Project the vector from the local player’s screen position (fallback: viewport centre) to the friend. Place the arrow at the intersection of that ray with an inset rectangle: 12 CSS px from the edges, plus extra inset so the 56×56 arrow never overlaps the pause+signal cluster (top-left), the jump/act cluster (bottom-right), or the emote button (closed-state anchor). Clamp the sprite fully on-screen. Assets are authored pointing UP; rotate so the tip points toward the friend. If two arrows would overlap, spread them by at least 8 CSS px along the edge.
edge_clamp.online_vs_couch: For online play, show whenever the friend is off-screen. The couch S8 12 m / 16 m / 20 m soft-warn in act3-shop-coop.md §2.5 is a separate kit and does not apply here.

copy.host_left_spec: The host's game ended. Back to your Meadow 🌼
copy.source: online-coop.md §3.3 and §3.7. The 🌼 and 💤 are omitted in rasters because DejaVu has no emoji; runtime should use the full spec strings.

signal.placement: 8 CSS px to the right of the pause button, 12 CSS px from the top-left.

states.weak: honey disc, 2 solid bars (right bar empty)

signal.non_colour_cue: Bar count, and an X on lost. Colour alone is not sufficient: mint vs honey grayscale ΔE is 9.4 (under the kit threshold of 10).

ghost.treatment: Idle animal is desaturated (near 0 saturation) and slightly lifted, under a dashed foam veil, with the honey reconnect glyph and the waiting-for-friend pill. The animal stays in place so it still holds plates. Slot reserved 60 s.

backdrops.source: /workspace/assets-incoming/art-direction/frame-B.png (1280×720, preset B, already a real in-game-style frame). Portrait and landscape are crops, not a fresh Playwright re-render, because 390×844 and 844×390 do not match 16:9.
backdrops.note: Mockup backgrounds only — not gameplay art to ship. The portrait play crop cannot fully contain raccoon through bear (span ~430 px vs a 333 px-wide slice); the accepted compromise shows the raccoon, the bee, and the bear’s head.

reuse.from: ../ui (online play UI kit). Referenced, not copied, and not edited.
items: chrome/card.png and chrome/btn-primary.png for the host-left end card
not_reused: act3/ui/coop/badge-p{1,2,plain}.png — labelled P1/P2 text chips, old styling, not the adopted colour+shape system.
act3/ui/coop/prompt-join — couch join prompt, out of scope.
online/ui/banners/reconnecting.png — a toast with a refresh glyph; a clean 48 CSS px reconnect glyph was drawn instead of cropping the banner.
online/ui/lobby/class-*.png — class diamonds, not animal faces.

colour_vision.method: Machado, Vieira & Oliveira 2009, severity 1.0, linear sRGB, CIE76, grayscale from relative luminance. Fail if grayscale ΔE < 10 for colour-only pairs.
colour_vision.player_fills: Tightest grayscale pair P2 vs P3, ΔE 14.9 (P1 vs P2 15.9, P1 vs P3 30.8). Matches ../ui/players/sim-report.json. Shapes travel with colour on every HUD mark.
colour_vision.signal: Mint vs honey grayscale ΔE 9.4 — under 10, which is why the icons also use 3 / 2 / 0 bars and an X. Mint vs coral gray 11.3; honey vs coral 20.8. Deutan mint vs coral 15.3 (tightest CVD colour pair); bars still separate them.

spec_conflicts.job: The host left the game / Back to meadow
spec_conflicts.spec: The host's game ended. Back to your Meadow 🌼  (online-coop.md §3.3 and §3.7)
spec_conflicts.decision: Follow the spec. Button label is “Back to your Meadow”. The 🌼 is omitted in rasters (DejaVu has no emoji) and should be present at runtime.
Same emoji limitation. Rasters use “waiting for friend”; runtime should include 💤.

spec_conflicts.note: act3-shop-coop.md §2.5 uses 12 m soft-warn / 16 m pull / 20 m cap for couch co-op. This HUD is for online play and shows an arrow whenever a friend is off-screen (or within 16 CSS px of an edge).
